scope: Canonical PGR schematic corrected; PCB layout deliberately unchanged.

hardware.battery_switch_MOSFETs: Q4 and Q9, DMP2035U-7 common-source back-to-back pair

changes: Corrected USB auto-program transistor orientation and reset timing.
Replaced marginal 5V boost and hot 3.3V LDO with TPS61230 and TLV62568; added TPS3808 reset supervisor.
Added normal low-battery cutoff near 3.21V with restart near 3.57V.
Added reverse-blocking source selection, protected USB fallback and separately limited modem/AquaNode supplies.
Added battery and solar reverse-polarity protection and a high-interrupting-capacity 3A cell fuse.
Implemented external cell NTC charge-temperature window and explicit approximately 24mA charge termination.
Corrected active-low status indicators and reduced optional LED consumption.
Separated RS485 receiver and driver enables; increased idle bias margin.
Added modem UART buffers with independent output enable to prevent phantom powering.
Moved tamper input to RTC-capable GPIO33 and solar status to GPIO34, freeing four JTAG pins.
Added battery/NTC telemetry, UART0 and JTAG access, and eight test points.
Reorganized the schematic onto A2 and preserved complete reviewed symbols in a project-local library.
Moved SW4 into a <40uA control path and added a back-to-back low-resistance MOSFET battery disconnect.
Added JP1 UART RX source selection to prevent CP2102/external-adapter output contention.
Excluded TH1 from the PCB and froze a project-local USB footprint with S1 shield numbering.

modem.sequence: Enable GPIO25, wait for module rail, then enable GPIO27. Disable GPIO27 before cutting GPIO25. Keep module powered if preserving PSM state.
modem.USB_only: Keep modem disabled when operating solely from USB fallback; total USB current is limited below 500mA.

AquaNode.policy: Keep powered while parent sleeps; power cycle only for recovery.

ADC.NTC: Configure appropriate ADC attenuation and calibrate probe.

JTAG.J13.5: GPIO12 TDI, keep low during boot

assembly.NTC: TH1 is offboard and excluded from PCB; retain Semitec103AT-2 probe in harness BOM through J12.
assembly.power_LED: D8 and R14 are DNP by default.
assembly.M5_cable: PGR J8.1 GND -> M5 black J1.4; J8.2 switched5V -> M5 red J1.3; J8.3 module RX -> M5 yellow J1.2; J8.4 module TX -> M5 white J1.1.
assembly.UART_selector: Fit one Harwin M7567-05 shunt on JP1: pins1-2 USB default, pins2-3 external UART. Never bridge all three.
assembly.USB_footprint: Use project-local PGR-FootPrints:USB_C_GCT_USB4105_PGR; shield pads S1 match schematic.

remaining_before_production: Synchronize the PCB with the corrected schematic, then place/route the changed power circuitry and run DRC.
Verify startup, solar/battery handover, USB fallback, modem current bursts, charge cutoff/temperature faults, reset and programming on a prototype.
Measure cable voltage drop at AquaNode under actual sensor load.
Confirm exact solar panel output, worst-month energy budget and measured station consumption.
Validate charge-temperature trip points using the actual mounted probe.
